nodes.label: V1 vendored verbatim (models.py / training.py / datasets.py)
nodes.rationale: Unmodified copies from tabjoint_vishal_averaged_experiments so V1 travels with v4 in one rsync and runs exactly as written; known quirks are kept as-is on purpose because this folder is the reference, not a fix.

nodes.label: V1 quirk: lambda_div multiplied by 0.0
nodes.rationale: V1's CKA diversity term never actually affects the loss — so V1's reported numbers were never produced by the diversity penalty it claims, which is part of why v4 concluded the penalty was unnecessary.

nodes.label: V1 quirk: resample_feature_subsets() is a no-op
nodes.rationale: Subsets are re-drawn with the same fixed seed every epoch, so the 'resampled' subsets are identical — V1's subsets were effectively fixed, the behaviour v4 adopted deliberately.

nodes.label: V1 quirk: metrics as mean of per-batch metrics
nodes.rationale: Averaging per-batch RMSE is not the true RMSE, so the v4 benchmark notebook recomputes every metric on the full split — otherwise the V1-vs-v4 comparison would be measuring two different quantities.
